name: tickerwall
description: A self-hosted market terminal: 20 global instruments, terminator world map, macro event stream, correlation matrix and an interactive transmission graph. One Node process.
//: 依赖策略见 README「依赖策略」：允许引入依赖；浏览器端依赖由 `npm run build` 打进 public/vendor/（产物入库，运行看板不需要 node_modules）。dependencies 只放「产物会间接 require」的包：tslib 是 @antv/x6 构建产物实际 import 但没写进它自己 dependencies 的包，必须显式装上。devDependencies 里 elkjs 只给 tools/layout-lab.mjs 做离线布局实验；d3-geo/d3-zoom/d3-selection/d3-transition/d3-interpolate/topojson-client/world-atlas 只用于构建 vendor/geo-kit.js 与跑单测，不进运行时。
